rationale: Bus 2 has an undervoltage violation (0.925 pu < 0.95 pu). To correct this, reactive power must be injected. The required voltage increase is 0.025 pu. Given the sensitivity of 0.006 pu/MVar, the minimum action required is 0.025 / 0.006 = 4.1667 MVar. This action is within the allowed bounds [0, 20] MVar and is the minimum cost solution.
